IS 1239 Hydro Tested Pipes
 are carbon steel pipes manufactured as per the 
Indian Standard IS 1239
, which specifies requirements for 
welded steel tubes for water, gas, and air
. Hydro testing is a critical quality control process applied to these pipes to ensure their strength, leak-tightness, and durability under pressure. These pipes are widely used in 
plumbing
, 
water supply
, 
irrigation
, and 
general engineering
 applications.
Key Features:
Standard:
 IS 1239 Part 1 (Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars, and Other Wrought Steel Fittings)
Type:
 Welded (ERW) pipes
Hydro Tested:
 Each pipe is hydrostatically tested to withstand specified pressure without leakage or deformation
Material:
 Mild Steel (usually Grade Fe 410 or equivalent)
Size Range:
Diameter: 15 mm to 300 mm (or as per order)
Wall Thickness: As per IS 1239 standard schedules
Length:
 Typically 6 meters or customized
Surface:
 Black painted or plain finish
Hydro Test Details:
Pipes undergo 
hydrostatic testing
 at a pressure higher than their working pressure
Ensures pipes are free from leaks, cracks, and defects
Confirms mechanical strength and pressure handling capacity
